title: Claim: hacker 'Chimera' says it leaked Les Gazons Parisiens customer and order data; company has not confirmed
geo_basis: Cyberattaque.org gives the company's base as Neuilly-sur-Marne
summary: Cyberattaque.org reports that a hacker calling itself Chimera claimed on 23 November a data leak from the French turf company Les Gazons Parisiens. The site says it analysed the archive, which contains personal data, order histories and payment-related data. It says no full card numbers or security codes were found in the fields it examined, and that as of 24 November it had found no official confirmation from the company; the intrusion date is unknown.
plain: A hacker claims to have leaked customer, order and payment-related data of a French turf seller. The company has not confirmed it, and the site that analysed the data says it found no full card numbers.
exec: A hacker's unconfirmed claim of a leak of customer and order data at a French online seller; the company has not confirmed it, per Cyberattaque.org.
action: General advice: customers of Les Gazons Parisiens should treat unexpected emails or calls about their orders with caution until the company issues a statement.
date_note: The claim was posted on 23 November per Cyberattaque.org, whose article is dated 24 November.

validation.note: Single publisher (Cyberattaque.org), which analysed the leaked archive itself; its page reports no statement from the company.
